question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an adverb-usage error.

Teacher Grace remarked, 'Quickly does he watch television'.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "Quickly does he watch television" contains an adverb-usage error.
 
• The placement of the adverb "Quickly" is incorrect, as it disrupts the natural word order in English.
 
• In standard English, the correct phrasing would be "He watches television quickly" or "Quickly, he watches television."
 
• Thus, the error lies in **Option 2**, which includes the incorrect usage of the adverb.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Teacher Grace remarked, 'He watches television quickly.'"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "remarked"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "Teacher Grace"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "watch television'"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
